modmenu.descriptionTranslation.xcraft: Multiply ore drops, mob drops, XP and furnace speed. Configurable, server-side, for Fabric, NeoForge & Forge.
xcraft.midnightconfig.title: xCraft Config
Multiplies what ores drop when mined (Silk Touch is unaffected); per-block values below take priority
xcraft.midnightconfig.entityDropMultipli: Multiplies the loot dropped by mobs (hostile/passive and per-mob values below take priority)
xcraft.midnightconfig.hostileMobDropMult: For hostile mobs (zombies, skeletons, slimes...); 0 = same as Mob Drop Multiplier
xcraft.midnightconfig.passiveMobDropMult: For every other mob (cows, villagers, wolves...); 0 = same as Mob Drop Multiplier
xcraft.midnightconfig.xpMultiplier.toolt: Multiplies the value of experience orbs
xcraft.midnightconfig.furnaceSpeedMultip: Makes furnaces, blast furnaces and smokers cook faster
xcraft.midnightconfig.blockDropMultiplie: Entries like minecraft:gravel=3; any block, overrides the ore multiplier
xcraft.midnightconfig.mobDropMultipliers: Entries like minecraft:zombie=5; overrides every other mob multiplier
